# RELATIONS The position of the Union toward the other powers present on the frontier, as stated by the mission. This page is revised whenever the situation changes, which is often.
## THE UNITED AMERICAS The Union has not forgotten [bold]Operation Canton[/bold], and regards it as an attempt to seize territory that belongs to the peoples of the Union. Relations have been cold ever since. Union ships and the Colonial Marines meet more often on the frontier every year. The mission asks all parties on this colony to avoid incidents that soldiers on either side would be ordered to answer.
## THE THREE WORLD EMPIRE The Empire contests the Outer Rim with the Union. Several of its far colonies have chosen to join the Union of their own will. The mission welcomes subjects of the Empire who wish to learn why.
## WEYLAND-YUTANI AND THE CORPORATIONS The Company represents everything the Union was founded to oppose. Where the Company has bought, sold or abandoned colonies, the Union has found people without food, without rights and without anyone to speak for them. Commercial dealings with corporations, where they occur, are matters of necessity and not of friendship.
## TRADE AND EMBARGO The Ambassador may, on the instruction of the Union, open a [bold]trade pact[/bold] with this colony or declare an [bold]embargo[/bold] against it. Both will be announced on this board. A colony that treats Union citizens fairly will find the Union a fair partner.
## THE COLONY The Union respects the authority of the colony administration in matters of daily life. It does not recognise any claim by a foreign military to search, detain or question Union citizens without the presence of the mission.
